findings.title: [Demo] Administrative route lacks an access check
findings.description: Synthetic example: an administrative route is modeled without an authorization check. Use this record to explore critical finding triage and ownership; no real service was scanned.
findings.recommendation: For this example, require an authenticated administrator before processing the route and add tests for anonymous and non-administrator requests.

findings.title: [Demo] Search query uses untrusted text directly
findings.description: Synthetic example: a search query is modeled as combining request text with database query syntax. This illustrates a high-priority application finding with a source location.
findings.recommendation: Use parameterized queries for values, validate any selectable sort fields against an allowlist, and test unusual search input.

findings.title: [Demo] Worker runs with unnecessary privileges
findings.description: Synthetic example: a background worker is modeled with broader operating-system privileges than its job requires. No container or cluster was inspected.
findings.recommendation: Run the worker as a dedicated non-root user, remove unnecessary capabilities, and verify that its normal tasks still succeed.

findings.title: [Demo] Account page renders an unescaped display name
findings.description: Synthetic example: a profile display name is modeled as being inserted into markup without the usual output escaping. The report contains no executable payload.
findings.recommendation: Render the display name as ordinary text. If rich text is required, sanitize it with a maintained library and test the allowed formatting.

findings.title: [Demo] Dependency update is awaiting verification
findings.description: Synthetic example: a fictional dependency has a pending maintenance update. The component name, version, and assessment are invented; this is not an advisory for a real package.
findings.recommendation: For the demo workflow, assign an owner to evaluate the fictional update, run document-processing tests, and record the outcome in a finding comment.

findings.title: [Demo] Server response includes a version banner
findings.description: Synthetic example: a proxy response is modeled as disclosing an unnecessary software version banner. This low-priority record helps demonstrate severity filtering.
findings.recommendation: Suppress unnecessary version details in response headers and verify the behavior with a response-header test.

findings.title: [Demo] Session cookie policy needs tightening
findings.description: Synthetic example: a session configuration is modeled with a more permissive cookie policy than the application's navigation requires. No cookie value or credential is included.
findings.recommendation: Review cross-site navigation requirements, select an appropriate SameSite policy, and verify that sign-in and sign-out continue to work.

findings.title: [Demo] Frontend inventory entry is available for review
findings.description: Synthetic informational record showing that frontend component metadata can be imported. This entry does not assert a vulnerability and contains no results from a real scan.
findings.recommendation: Review the component metadata, add a demo comment, and close the record when you have finished exploring the triage workflow.
